title: CassandraPersonalization app ran into 'Timed out waiting for server response'

```
W0328 16:45:12.656280 13583 column_family.cc:587] T 271a11e2903545919ed029f5cd384203: [default] Stopping writes because we have 2 immutable memtables (waiting for flush), max_write_buffer_number is set to 2
...
E0328 16:45:32.214391 14030 process_context.cc:179] SQL Error: Tablet Not Found. Not found (yb/client/meta_cache.cc:602): Failed Write(tablet: 271a11e2903545919ed029f5cd384203, num_ops: 150, num_attempts: 2) to tablet 271a11e2903545919ed029f5cd384203 (no tablet server available) after 2 attempt(s): LookupByIdRpc(271a11e2903545919ed029f5cd384203, 1) failed: No such tablet found
INSERT INTO PerfTest_0 (customer_id, store_id, coupon_code, begin_date, end_date, relevance_score) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
^^^^^^
```

Not clear why the writes are not enabled and it keeps failing for 20+ seconds. May be the writes were not set back to enabled...

All the logs from tserver/master are in /home/centos/save/20180328_182153 ('ssh -i <some_private_key> -p <some_port> centos@<some_ip_address>')

Need some folks with rocksdb to take a further look... Cc: @mbautin, @robertpang
